sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟人聊天中的英语夹用可自然出现；正式马来语按语义采用 sayap、kepak 或 pemain sayap。kau 只用于合适的熟人关系。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 点餐时可按菜单名称说 chicken wing；政治讨论中的 sayap kiri、sayap kanan 表示派别或立场，不应用来随意给他人贴标签。

etymology.historical_story: English wing entered Middle English from Old Norse vængr. The physical image of something extending sideways helped support meanings involving buildings, armies and political factions. Theatre usage also applies the word to the sides of a stage. These connected images help learners organize the senses, while Malay commonly expresses several of them with sayap. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/wing); [Malay equivalents](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=sayap).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住“向两侧伸出”的画面：鸟翅、机翼、翼楼、侧翼；英语 wing 对应的马来语常是 sayap。ng 收成鼻音，不补读 g。[Cambridge 发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/wing)

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语混用或引用中作为英语整词处理，不能把 wiz-、-ard 当作马来语词素。IPA 采用常见英国英语读法。英语历史构词与现代马来语词缀分析分开处理。

senses.zh_definition: 巫师；术士：奇幻故事或游戏中能够施展魔法的人物。
senses.en_definition: A person with magical powers, especially a character in fantasy fiction or games.
senses.ms_definition: Watak atau orang yang mempunyai kuasa sihir, khususnya dalam cerita fantasi atau permainan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词在马来语语境中的引用或混用；一般马来语可用 ahli sihir。不能把它与进行舞台表演的 ahli silap mata 完全等同。马来文释义为本条编写，并非 DBP 官方释义引文；status 按指定模板保留，不表示 DBP 认证。英语义项参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/wizard)。

senses.zh_definition: 操作向导；设置向导：通过连续步骤引导用户完成安装、配置等任务的软件功能。
senses.en_definition: A software feature that guides a user through a task in a sequence of steps.
senses.ms_definition: Ciri perisian yang membimbing pengguna menyelesaikan sesuatu tugas melalui beberapa langkah berturutan.
senses.nuances: 常作为英文界面术语出现；正式马来文可根据具体界面解释为 panduan langkah demi langkah。此义指软件功能，并非负责操作电脑的人。界面中的具体按钮与功能名称应按原文引用。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/wizard)。

senses.zh_definition: 高手；奇才：在某项技能，尤其是计算机技术方面格外熟练的人。
senses.en_definition: A person who is exceptionally skilled in a particular activity, especially computing.
senses.ms_definition: Seseorang yang sangat mahir dalam sesuatu bidang, khususnya penggunaan atau pengendalian komputer.
senses.nuances: 属于带赞赏色彩的英语比喻用法；在马来语聊天中使用时带有语码混用色彩。正式介绍通常直接用 pakar 或 sangat mahir。DBP 的《计算机词典》以 bestari 对应精通电脑的 wizard，这一记录不能用来证明软件向导义也采用同一译法。参见 [PRPM：bestari](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bestari)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场操作说明 / 软件安装
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengguna hendaklah mengikuti arahan dalam 'wizard' pemasangan sehingga proses selesai.
dual_scenarios.zh: 用户应按照安装向导中的指示操作，直至流程完成。
dual_scenarios.en: Users must follow the instructions in the installation wizard until the process is complete.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事协助安装软件
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Wizard tu dah keluar. Aku kena tekan butang mana?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Panduan pemasangan itu sudah dipaparkan. Butang manakah yang perlu saya tekan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 安装向导出来了。我该点哪个按钮？
dual_scenarios.en: The wizard's come up. Which button should I click?
spoken_features: wizard 是英语软件术语，嵌入马来语句子形成语码混用。
tu、dah 分别对应 itu、sudah。
kena 在这里表示“需要”，不表示遭受。
nak、je、lah 使回复具有熟人聊天的自然语气。

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Wizard tu dah keluar. Aku nak pasang kat komputer ni je. Kena tekan butang mana?
messages.ms_standard: Panduan pemasangan itu sudah dipaparkan. Saya mahu memasang perisian ini pada komputer ini sahaja. Butang manakah yang perlu saya tekan?
messages.zh: 安装向导出来了。我只想装在这台电脑上。该点哪个按钮？
messages.en: The wizard's come up. I only want to install it on this computer. Which button should I click?

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Pilih pemasangan untuk komputer ni, lepas tu tekan 'Next'. Ikut arahan sampai habis je lah.
messages.ms_standard: Pilih pemasangan untuk komputer ini, kemudian tekan butang 'Next'. Ikuti arahan sehingga proses selesai.
messages.zh: 选安装到这台电脑，然后点“Next”。照着提示走完就行。
messages.en: Choose installation on this computer, then click 'Next'. Just follow the prompts to the end.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称赞朋友是 wizard 通常带欣赏意味，但较随意。向客户或上级介绍技术人员时，使用 pakar teknologi maklumat 或说明具体专长更清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 奇幻、软件和能力赞美三个义项须由上下文区分。正式马来文可解释或翻译英语术语；引用英文软件界面时保留原标签，方便读者对应实际操作。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称赞朋友是 wizard 通常带欣赏意味，但较随意。向客户或上级介绍技术人员时，使用 pakar teknologi maklumat 或说明具体专长更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 奇幻、软件和能力赞美三个义项须由上下文区分。正式马来文可解释或翻译英语术语；引用英文软件界面时保留原标签，方便读者对应实际操作。

etymology.historical_story: Wizard developed from Middle English wysard, associated with being wise. Its older sense was a sage or learned person; the magical specialist became a later, distinct meaning. Modern English also uses the word admiringly for someone with exceptional skill. Remembering this connection between wisdom and extraordinary ability makes both the fantasy character and the computer expert easier to understand. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/wizard).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wizard 与英语 wise“有智慧的”联系起来：故事里是懂魔法的高手，电脑里是带你完成步骤的“高手向导”。现代拼写不同，不能直接当作马来语构词公式。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是无词缀的基本词，整体记忆；j 读 /dʒ/，不拆成 wa- 与 -jar。

word_family.gloss: 使显得合理；为……提供正当理由

senses.zh_definition: 符合具体情况、道理或应有标准的；合理、适当或正当的。
senses.en_definition: Reasonable, appropriate, or justified in the circumstances.
senses.ms_definition: Sebagaimana yang sepatutnya, bersesuaian dengan keadaan dan dapat diterima sebagai munasabah.
senses.nuances: 常用于评价决定、要求或待遇是否合理。接动词短语时，如 wajar dipertimbangkan，通常译为“应当考虑”或“值得考虑”；这表达适当性判断，语气通常弱于 wajib 所表示的义务。[DBP：wajar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=wajar)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Cadangan untuk melanjutkan tempoh permohonan adalah wajar kerana ramai pemohon masih menunggu dokumen sokongan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 延长申请期限的建议是合理的，因为许多申请人仍在等待证明文件。
dual_scenarios.en: The proposal to extend the application period is reasonable because many applicants are still waiting for supporting documents.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku rasa tak wajar kita salahkan dia je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya berpendapat bahawa tidak wajar kita menyalahkan dia sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我觉得光怪他一个人不太公平。
dual_scenarios.en: I don't think it's fair to blame only him.
spoken_features: aku 是熟人之间的第一人称代词，正式交流通常使用 saya。
tak 对应 tidak；je 对应 sahaja。
salahkan 在此省略了标准主动句中的前缀 meny-，标准形式为 menyalahkan。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku rasa tak wajar kita salahkan Amir je. Arahan tu pun tak jelas.
messages.ms_standard: Saya berpendapat bahawa tidak wajar kita menyalahkan Amir sahaja. Arahan itu juga tidak jelas.
messages.zh: 我觉得不能光怪 Amir，指示本来也不清楚。
messages.en: I don't think it's fair to blame only Amir. The instructions weren't clear either.

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Betul juga. Kita dengar penjelasan dia dulu lah sebelum buat keputusan.
messages.ms_standard: Pendapat itu ada benarnya. Kita perlu mendengar penjelasannya dahulu sebelum membuat keputusan.
messages.zh: 也是。先听听他的解释，再做决定吧。
messages.en: You have a point. Let's hear his side before we decide.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 评价他人行为时，tidak wajar 带有明确否定。职场中可用 saya rasa kurang wajar（我觉得不太妥当）缓和语气，并说明具体理由。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论措施、分配、要求和决定是否合情合理。表达建议可用 wajar dipertimbangkan；若要表达强制义务，应根据语境使用必须性更明确的词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 评价他人行为时，tidak wajar 带有明确否定。职场中可用 saya rasa kurang wajar（我觉得不太妥当）缓和语气，并说明具体理由。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论措施、分配、要求和决定是否合情合理。表达建议可用 wajar dipertimbangkan；若要表达强制义务，应根据语境使用必须性更明确的词。

etymology.historical_story: DBP 记录的 wajar 既能描述“不加修饰、原本如此”，也能评价事物“合乎应有的样子”；可以把两者联系成从本来状态到合宜标准的词义图景，但这不等于已经确定了历史演变次序。爪哇语词典也记录同形词 wajar，具有普通、自然及合乎情理的意思，然而这些资料尚不足以确定借词方向或借入年代。[DBP：wajar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=wajar)；[爪哇语官方词典：wajar](https://kbji.kemendikdasmen.go.id/kata/wajar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一架天平：一边放具体情况，另一边放决定；两边分量相称，就是 wajar——合情合理、恰到好处。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中不作词缀拆分。所列音标为常见英语读法；具体人名以本人读法为准。数据包未提供音节与爪夷文，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 威利：英语人名 Willie 在马来语文本中的保留写法，常与 William 的昵称有关。
senses.en_definition: Willie, a personal name commonly used as a diminutive of William.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, Willie, yang lazimnya merupakan bentuk panggilan bagi William.
senses.nuances: 此处按专名提供释义；数据包缺少原句，不能确定具体人物，也不能认定为 DBP 官方普通词头。正文应写 Willie。以下搭配是自然的人名组合，未经搭配频率验证。英语小写 willie 另有儿童用语中的身体部位义，不能仅凭大小写归一化后的词形将其并入马来语义项。[人名来源](https://www.behindthename.com/name/willie)；[英语同形词](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/willie)。马来文定义为编辑释义。

etymology.historical_story: Willie belongs to the English tradition of familiar personal names and is commonly associated with William. When such a name appears in Malay, it identifies a person rather than acquiring a new Malay dictionary meaning. Malaysian parliamentary records provide an example of Willie used as a personal name, although this packet does not identify its particular bearer. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/willie); [Malaysian usage](https://parlimen.gov.my/files/hindex/pdf/DR-25022025.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /ˈwɪli/ 联想成“威利”这张姓名牌：先认人名，再看上下文，不拆马来语词缀。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语姓氏，在马来语中作为完整专名使用，规范书写为 Williams。词尾 -s 不是马来语词缀；所列 IPA 为英语读音。数据包未提供音节划分及爪夷文，保留 null；未确认马来语派生词，词族留空。

senses.zh_definition: 威廉斯：英语姓氏，在马来语文本中用于指称具有此姓的人。
senses.en_definition: An English-language surname used unchanged as a proper name in Malay texts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan sebagai nama khas dalam teks bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 属专有名词，不能脱离上下文确定指哪位人物，也不能据此认定其国籍。以下搭配是自然的姓名使用结构，不是经语料统计确认的固定搭配。释义为编辑撰写，未核实 DBP 普通词条，因此不标为 official。姓氏读音及来源参见 [Behind the Name：Williams](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/williams)。

etymology.historical_story: Williams is a surname historically associated with the meaning 'son of William'. In a Malay sentence, it remains a person's inherited name rather than a word describing an action or quality. Its final s belongs to the surname's history and must not be analysed as a productive Malay suffix. See [Behind the Name](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/williams).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Williams 想成会议桌上的“威廉斯先生”名牌：它用来认人，不用来表达普通词义。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是 kamu 的附着式，在此表示第二人称领属，并非派生词缀；连接时词根不变，h 仍保留。按所给字段以 suffix 标记其位置。音节由词形推得；资料包 Jawi واجه 是词根写法，完整 wajahmu 可写作 واجهمو。[DBP 拼写规则](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 你的脸庞或面容，指被称为“你”的人的脸。
senses.en_definition: Your face or countenance.
senses.ms_definition: Muka atau air muka orang yang disapa sebagai kamu.
senses.nuances: 这是 wajah 加第二人称领属附着式 -mu，整体仍作名词使用。wajah 比 muka 更有描写色彩，wajahmu 常见于诗歌、歌词及亲密表达；日常交谈更常说 muka awak、muka kau 或 wajah awak。核心面容义依据 [DBP wajah 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=wajah)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam ulasan buku itu, frasa "wajahmu yang tenang" ditafsirkan sebagai gambaran ketenteraman orang yang disapa.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在该书评中，“你平静的面容”这一短语被解读为对受话人内心安宁的描写。
dual_scenarios.en: In the book review, the phrase "your calm face" is interpreted as a portrayal of the addressee's inner peace.

句末 ke 表示口语疑问。
wajahmu 在这里带亲昵、略有诗意的语气，并非最中性的日常说法。

messages.ms_standard: Wajahmu kelihatan ceria pada hari ini. Adakah kamu menerima berita baik?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -mu 带有直接称呼对方的意味，适合亲密关系或文学表达。对长辈、客户及初次见面的人，通常采用 wajah encik、wajah puan 或合适称谓更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: wajahmu 是规范的连写形式，但不因此适用于所有正式沟通。面对面评价他人容貌时应照顾关系与感受，避免让关心听起来像审视外表。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -mu 带有直接称呼对方的意味，适合亲密关系或文学表达。对长辈、客户及初次见面的人，通常采用 wajah encik、wajah puan 或合适称谓更得体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: wajahmu 是规范的连写形式，但不因此适用于所有正式沟通。面对面评价他人容貌时应照顾关系与感受，避免让关心听起来像审视外表。

etymology.historical_story: 词根 wajah 借自阿拉伯语 وَجْه（wajh，脸、面容），进入马来语后形成 wa.jah 的读法。马来语再把表示“你的”的 -mu 接在词后，让原本泛指的面容成为诗歌或私语里直接面对某个人的“你的脸庞”。[词源参考](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/wajah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜头对准对方的脸：wajah 是“面容”，-mu 把镜头指向“你”，合起来就是“你的面容”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按专名整体记忆，不作现代马来语词根与词缀拆分。输入小写形式已恢复专名大写；IPA 为英式英语姓名读音。没有可据此建立的马来语派生词族，Watsons 也不是添加马来语后缀形成的词。

senses.zh_definition: 沃森；华生等：英语姓氏及相关专名，具体中文译名随人物或实体而定。
senses.en_definition: An English-language surname, also used in personal and institutional names.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan sebagai nama khas orang atau entiti tertentu.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不是具有统一普通词义的马来语词。Dr. Watson 在福尔摩斯故事中通常译作华生医生；其他人物应采用其通行译名。姓氏资料见 [Oxford Dictionary of Family Names in Britain and Ireland](https://downloads.freemdict.com/%E5%B0%9A%E6%9C%AA%E6%95%B4%E7%90%86/%E5%85%B1%E4%BA%AB2020.5.11/content/1_english/3_Oxford%20series/The%20Oxford%20Dictionary%20of%20Family%20Names%20in%20Britain%20and%20Ireland/The%20Oxford%20Dictionary%20of%20Family%20Names%20in%20Britain%20and%20Ireland.pdf)。本条马来文释义为专名说明，并非 DBP 普通词条定义。

collocations.zh: 华生医生；沃森医生，视人物而定

senses.zh_definition: 在购物语境中，可能指屈臣氏 Watsons；须结合上下文判断。
senses.en_definition: In shopping contexts, a possible informal reference to the retailer Watsons.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam konteks membeli-belah, bentuk tidak rasmi yang mungkin merujuk kepada rangkaian kedai Watsons.
senses.nuances: 不能仅凭 watson 这个孤立词形确定其指屈臣氏；此义是有条件的语境推断。品牌规范名称为 Watsons，须保留末尾 s。以下搭配采用品牌规范拼写。品牌背景见 [AS Watson 官方历史](https://www.aswatson.com/key-milestones)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼真实人物时采用对方认可的姓名与头衔；Encik Watson 适用于相应男性，已知博士或医生头衔时可用 Dr. Watson。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式文件保留专名大写，并核对具体实体名称。购物语境写 Watsons；涉及人物、机构或其他产品时，不应自动译成屈臣氏。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称呼真实人物时采用对方认可的姓名与头衔；Encik Watson 适用于相应男性，已知博士或医生头衔时可用 Dr. Watson。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式文件保留专名大写，并核对具体实体名称。购物语境写 Watsons；涉及人物、机构或其他产品时，不应自动译成屈臣氏。

etymology.historical_story: Watson is a surname meaning son of Wat, a familiar form of Walter. A separate commercial story explains its visibility in Malaysia: Alexander Skirving Watson joined the Hong Kong business in 1858, the dispensary adopted the AS Watson name in 1871, and Watsons expanded to Malaysia in 1994. The retail brand retains its final s. [Oxford surname dictionary](https://downloads.freemdict.com/%E5%B0%9A%E6%9C%AA%E6%95%B4%E7%90%86/%E5%85%B1%E4%BA%AB2020.5.11/content/1_english/3_Oxford%20series/The%20Oxford%20Dictionary%20of%20Family%20Names%20in%20Britain%20and%20Ireland/The%20Oxford%20Dictionary%20of%20Family%20Names%20in%20Britain%20and%20Ireland.pdf), [AS Watson history](https://www.aswatson.com/key-milestones)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 人名记 Watson，购物认 Watsons：去屈臣氏时，别把招牌最后的 s 丢了。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词根使用，不拆分为词缀与词干。

senses.zh_definition: 有权继承死者遗产的人或一方；继承人。
senses.en_definition: A person or party entitled to inherit the property of someone who has died; an heir.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau pihak yang berhak menerima pusaka orang yang telah meninggal dunia.
senses.nuances: 本义强调继承人的身份，不能与表示遗产的 warisan 混用。表格中的 maklumat waris 有时指家属或紧急联系人资料，须按具体语境理解。

pasal 在此口语中表示 tentang，即“关于”。

messages.speaker: Aina (姐姐)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 涉及丧亲与遗产时，措辞宜平和、体谅家属；不要用带有争抢意味的语气谈论 waris。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论继承身份时使用 waris；填写联系资料时，先看清表格对 waris 的具体说明。称呼在场家属时通常直接使用姓名或合适的亲属称谓。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 涉及丧亲与遗产时，措辞宜平和、体谅家属；不要用带有争抢意味的语气谈论 waris。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论继承身份时使用 waris；填写联系资料时，先看清表格对 waris 的具体说明。称呼在场家属时通常直接使用姓名或合适的亲属称谓。

etymology.historical_story: waris 源自阿拉伯语 wārith，意为“继承人”，进入马来语后保留了领取遗产者这一核心意义。它又衍生出 mewarisi“继承”和 warisan“遗产、传承”，使同一词族能够分别表达继承者、继承行为与所传之物。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=waris)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张家族照片旁放着遗产文件：接过文件的人是 waris，文件所代表的遗产是 warisan。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词根使用，不拆成 was- 与 pada；派生时保留词根首辅音 w。

senses.zh_definition: 对潜在危险、欺骗或异常情况保持警觉，谨慎防范的。
senses.en_definition: Alert to possible danger or deception and careful to avoid harm.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak cuai, berawas-awas, berhati-hati, berjaga-jaga dan beringat-ingat.
senses.nuances: 强调对可能出现的风险保持注意，比一般表示小心的 berhati-hati 更突出警戒意识。常用于安全提醒、诈骗防范和风险通报；日常聊天也能使用，但语气通常较认真。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Orang ramai dinasihatkan supaya sentiasa waspada terhadap penipuan dalam talian.
dual_scenarios.zh: 当局提醒公众时刻警惕网络诈骗。
dual_scenarios.en: Members of the public are advised to remain vigilant against online scams.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kena waspada kalau dapat mesej macam ni, jangan terus tekan pautan tu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kita perlu waspada apabila menerima mesej seperti ini dan tidak sepatutnya terus menekan pautan itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 收到这种信息要警惕，别马上点那个链接。
dual_scenarios.en: Be careful if you get a message like this. Don’t click the link straight away.
spoken_features: kena 在此表示必须或需要，对应 perlu。
macam ni 对应 seperti ini。
tu 对应 itu。
省略泛指主语，使提醒更简短直接。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dapat mesej kata menang hadiah. Dia nak nombor akaun aku.
messages.ms_standard: Saya menerima mesej yang menyatakan bahawa saya memenangi hadiah. Pengirimnya meminta nombor akaun saya.
messages.zh: 我收到信息说我中奖了，对方还要我的银行账号。
messages.en: I got a message saying I’d won a prize. They’re asking for my bank account number.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kena waspada lah. Jangan bagi apa-apa maklumat dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Kamu perlu waspada. Jangan berikan sebarang maklumat buat masa ini.
messages.zh: 要警惕啊。先别提供任何资料。
messages.en: Be careful. Don’t give them any information yet.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于提醒通常表达关心；对客户、长辈或公众可说 Sila sentiasa waspada，语气较有礼貌。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 最好同时说明需要防范的具体风险。Kena waspada 适合熟人聊天；正式通知宜采用 dinasihatkan supaya sentiasa waspada 等表达。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于提醒通常表达关心；对客户、长辈或公众可说 Sila sentiasa waspada，语气较有礼貌。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 最好同时说明需要防范的具体风险。Kena waspada 适合熟人聊天；正式通知宜采用 dinasihatkan supaya sentiasa waspada 等表达。

etymology.historical_story: waspada 的词源通常联系到爪哇语及古爪哇语的同形词，古义涉及清楚、明晰。可以把它的语义发展理解为从看清情况走向警觉戒备；现代马来语主要用它表达对风险保持清醒注意。[词源参考：Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/waspada)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手机收到陌生中奖信息时，脑中亮起一盏警示灯：先看清、再行动，这种清醒戒备的状态就是 waspada。

morphology.pattern_note: wangi 是完整词根，不能拆成 wang（钱）加 -i；输入包的 wang 词根标注在此更正。ng 表示单个鼻辅音 /ŋ/。

senses.zh_definition: 香的；散发令人愉悦的气味的。
senses.en_definition: Fragrant; having a pleasant smell.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat sedap baunya; harum.
senses.nuances: 形容花朵、香水、衣物或食物等气味宜人。wangi 表示香气，不等于气味浓烈；bau kuat 只表示气味强，未必好闻。minyak wangi 是表示香水的固定组合。[DBP 释义与派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=wangi)

dual_scenarios.context: 产品介绍 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sabun ini menghasilkan buih yang lembut dan meninggalkan bau yang wangi pada pakaian.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这款肥皂产生细腻的泡沫，并使衣物留有怡人的香气。
dual_scenarios.en: This soap produces a gentle lather and leaves a pleasant fragrance on clothes.

spoken_features: ni 对应 ini。
lah 在这里加强赞叹语气。
kau 用于熟人之间。
guna 对应标准语的 gunakan，此处采用口语主动句式。

messages.ms_standard: Baju ini sangat wangi! Sabun apakah yang kamu gunakan?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称赞花、食物或衣物的香气通常自然得体。称赞不熟悉的人的身体气味可能显得过于亲近，可具体称赞香水，如 Minyak wangi awak harum。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 表示食物闻起来香可说 Masakan ini wangi；评价吃起来好吃则用 sedap。wangi 可用于称赞，但不表示香味越浓越好。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称赞花、食物或衣物的香气通常自然得体。称赞不熟悉的人的身体气味可能显得过于亲近，可具体称赞香水，如 Minyak wangi awak harum。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 表示食物闻起来香可说 Masakan ini wangi；评价吃起来好吃则用 sedap。wangi 可用于称赞，但不表示香味越浓越好。

etymology.historical_story: 在现代马来语中，wangi 以完整词根表示宜人的香气，并形成 mewangikan、wangian 和 kewangian 等相关词。词典还记录了从嗅觉向社会评价的意义延伸：一个人的名字也可以变得 wangi，表达声誉良好、名声远扬；这说明香气如何成为好名声的形象比喻。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一朵花散出香气，旁边写着 wangi；再把这股香气连到 minyak wangi（香水），用气味画面记住整个词。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根 waris 加名词后缀 -an，字母和元音不变；词根末尾 s 在连读中成为后续音节的起始辅音。

senses.zh_definition: 由前人或上一代留下并传承下来的事物，包括财物、文化、传统及知识；遗产。
senses.en_definition: Something inherited or passed down from earlier generations, including property, traditions, and cultural heritage.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang diwarisi, sesuatu yang turun-temurun; peninggalan.
senses.nuances: 可指家庭留下的财物，也常指社会共同传承的文化与传统。waris 通常指有权继承的人，warisan 则指所传下来的事物。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=waris)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Program ini bertujuan memelihara warisan budaya untuk generasi akan datang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这项计划旨在为后代保存文化遗产。
dual_scenarios.en: This programme aims to preserve cultural heritage for future generations.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Resipi ni warisan keluarga aku. Nenek dah ajar mak cara buat.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Resipi ini ialah warisan keluarga saya. Nenek sudah mengajar ibu cara menyediakan hidangan ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这个食谱是我们家传下来的，奶奶已经教过妈妈怎么做了。
dual_scenarios.en: This recipe has been passed down in my family. Grandma taught Mum how to make it.
spoken_features: ni、dah 分别对应 ini、sudah。
口语判断句常省略 ialah。

etymology.historical_story: 词根 waris 是阿拉伯语借词，在马来语中主要指有权承接遗产的人；加上 -an 后，warisan 指传承下来的事物。这个词的使用范围既包括家庭财物，也包括一代代留下的文化、知识与传统，如同把上一代交到手中的东西继续传下去。[DBP 词源与派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=waris)

etymology.historical_story: English wall continues Old English weall, ultimately borrowed from Latin vallum, a defensive rampart. Its physical meaning later supplied a metaphor for a surface where people leave public messages. In Malaysian Malay conversation, the English form can appear inside Malay sentences; its presence does not make it a native Malay root. [Merriam-Webster: wall](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/wall).

senses.zh_definition: 喂；嘿；用于叫住熟人或引起对方注意的非正式呼语。
senses.en_definition: An informal call used to address someone or attract their attention: hey.
senses.ms_definition: Seruan tidak rasmi untuk menyapa seseorang atau menarik perhatiannya, khususnya dalam kalangan rakan sebaya.
senses.nuances: 功能上属于感叹性呼语；因指定词性列表没有 interjection，归入 particle。亲密语气可以表示熟络，尖锐或高声呼喊则可能显得无礼；不宜把它理解为适用于所有人的 hello。研究记录了青少年使用 wei/weh，并讨论其礼貌限制。马来语释义为概括，非 DBP 词典原文。[青少年语言礼貌研究](https://ptsldigital.ukm.my/jspui/bitstream/123456789/577617/1/ukmvital_78135%2BSource01%2BSource010.PDF)。

etymology.historical_story: Wei belongs to the everyday repertoire of informal Malaysian interaction. Research on adolescent speech records wei and weh as attention-getting forms and discusses their politeness limitations. The evidence establishes social use, not a definitive origin. Similar-sounding calls in other languages do not, by themselves, prove that this Malaysian form was borrowed from any particular language. [Research on adolescent politeness](https://ptsldigital.ukm.my/jspui/bitstream/123456789/577617/1/ukmvital_78135%2BSource01%2BSource010.PDF).

etymology.historical_story: English warren entered through medieval French forms associated with land reserved for game. Its meaning developed toward rabbit burrows and later extended figuratively to confusing networks of rooms or streets. That semantic journey makes the underground image useful for learners. The surname Warren has several possible histories, so a person's name should not automatically receive the rabbit-related explanation. See [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/warren) and [FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=Warren).

etymology.historical_story: Wade belongs to the South Indian food tradition familiar through the name vadai, from Tamil வடை. Its Malay dictionary spelling preserves a local pronunciation ending in /e/. DBP describes a ring-shaped fritter made from white dal, while the wider vadai tradition includes other forms. The name carries culinary knowledge across languages and communities.

senses.zh_definition: 威士忌：以大麦、燕麦、黑麦等谷物为原料酿制并蒸馏的烈酒。
senses.en_definition: Whisky; a distilled alcoholic spirit made from grain such as barley, oats, or rye.

etymology.historical_story: Wiski corresponds to English whisky or whiskey. Behind the English name lies the Gaelic expression uisge beatha, meaning water of life. Scottish tax records mention distilling in 1494, long before today's international whisky industry. This history explains the source name; it does not establish when the Malay spelling first entered use. [Scotch Whisky Association: name](https://www.scotch-whisky.org.uk/discover-scotch/faqs/), [historical record](https://www.scotch-whisky.org.uk/discover-scotch/story-of-scotch/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: wiski 与英语 whisky、中文“威士忌”一起记；马来语拼写按 wis-ki 两拍读，不添加额外音节。

senses.ms_definition: Bilik atau bahagian di sesebuah hospital yang menjadi tempat tinggal para pesakit, biasanya mereka yang mengalami penyakit yang sama, untuk menjalani rawatan.
senses.nuances: 可指整个病区，不一定是单人房。masuk wad 通常表示入院接受住院治疗；单纯到医院看诊不一定涉及 wad。

etymology.historical_story: Wad is the Malay adaptation of English ward, retaining its hospital meaning in a compact spelling. A Malaysian study of literary adaptation explicitly pairs ward with wad. The word also takes Malay affixes: mengewadkan means admitting someone to a ward, showing how an imported hospital term participates in Malay word formation. [Source](https://ir.upsi.edu.my/files/docs/2020/886_886.pdf)

headword.lexical_note: 英语词，不能依据本数据包认证为正式马来语词。通常对应 mengapa 或 kenapa。排名仅沿用输入；音节及爪夷文缺失值保留为 null。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语独立词，不适用马来语词缀分析。所列读音为单音节，字母 y 表示双元音 /aɪ/；部分英语口音保留 /ʍ/ 起音。

senses.zh_definition: 为什么；出于什么原因。用于直接或间接询问原因。
senses.en_definition: For what reason; used in direct or indirect questions.
senses.ms_definition: Mengapa atau kenapa; digunakan untuk menanyakan sebab secara langsung atau tidak langsung.
senses.nuances: 词性描述针对英语 why。正式马来语通常使用 mengapa；kenapa 常用于日常交流。下列搭配为马来语对应表达，马来语释义为编辑撰写，非 DBP 原文。

senses.ms_definition: Digunakan untuk memperkenalkan klausa yang menjelaskan sebab sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 这是英语关系副词用法，如 the reason why。翻译为马来语时常重组为 sebab、itulah sebabnya 等，不应逐词硬译。

senses.zh_definition: 原因；缘由，尤见于谈论事情来龙去脉的表达。
senses.en_definition: A reason or explanation, especially in expressions about underlying causes.
senses.ms_definition: Sebab atau penjelasan tentang sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 英语名词用法常见于复数 whys 或固定表达 the whys and wherefores；马来语以 sebab、alasan 或 sebab-musabab 表达。

senses.zh_definition: 哎呀；咦。置于话语开头表示惊讶或加强情绪，不询问原因。
senses.en_definition: An exclamation expressing surprise or emotional emphasis.
senses.ms_definition: Seruan yang menyatakan kehairanan atau menguatkan perasaan, bukan pertanyaan tentang sebab.
senses.nuances: 这里用 particle 容纳英语感叹词功能。此用法在现代日常英语中可带旧式或戏剧化色彩；不能译作 mengapa。

etymology.historical_story: English why descends from Old English hwī or hwȳ, historically a form associated with hwæt, meaning what. Its older grammatical sense concerned the cause or means of something. Modern English retains why as a basic question word. When it appears in Malay conversation, it may represent English code-switching rather than an established Malay borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: why /waɪ/ 一出现，就先找“原因”；马来语用 mengapa，日常也常用 kenapa。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Wukong → Wukong（外来专名，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包保留小写检索词，正文中的人物专名写作 Wukong。不可套用马来语词缀拆分。资料包没有提供核定的马来语读音或 Jawi，因此保留 null；其中文来源为 Wùkōng（悟空）。

senses.zh_definition: 专名“悟空”，在这里暂按《西游记》人物孙悟空解释；也可能用于相关改编作品、角色或其他命名，具体所指须结合出处。
senses.en_definition: The proper name Wukong, provisionally interpreted here as Sun Wukong, the Monkey King in Journey to the West.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas Wukong, yang dalam entri ini ditafsirkan sementara sebagai Sun Wukong, watak Raja Monyet dalam novel klasik Cina Journey to the West.
senses.nuances: 词性 noun 在此代表专有名词。资料包不足以确定唯一指称；采用孙悟空这一解释属于明确标示的推断，不能据此认定 wukong 是 DBP 收录的马来语普通词，也不能擅自解释为某款游戏。以下例句均采用文学人物这一暂定解释，搭配为说明性组合，不宣称有词频验证。[新加坡国家图书馆：四大名著简介](https://www.nlb.gov.sg/main/about-us/press-room-and-publications/media-releases/2025/-/media/1D48ACCB11944ACC92054DCA9916B377.ashx)

etymology.historical_story: Wukong is the romanized Chinese name 悟空, associated here with Sun Wukong, the Monkey King of Journey to the West. The late-Ming novel follows a pilgrimage to obtain Buddhist scriptures, with Wukong accompanying the monk Tang Sanzang. This literary background explains the name's cultural familiarity; it does not establish an independent Malay dictionary word. [NLB literary background](https://www.nlb.gov.sg/main/about-us/press-room-and-publications/media-releases/2025/-/media/1D48ACCB11944ACC92054DCA9916B377.ashx)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Wukong 直接对应“悟空”：把拼写同孙悟空的形象绑定；它是名字，不是需要拆词缀的马来语词。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是第一人称领属附着语，表示“我的”，与前词连写；此处借用 suffix 类别记录，并非派生后缀。词干不变。音节据完整词形补全；所保留的数据包 Jawi واجه 仅表示 wajah，完整词形为 واجهکو。

senses.zh_definition: 我的脸、面容或脸上呈现的神情。
senses.en_definition: My face, countenance, or facial expression.
senses.ms_definition: Muka, paras atau air muka aku.
senses.nuances: wajah 比 muka 更常见于描写、抒情或较讲究的表达。-ku 明确表示第一人称领属，因此不能直接把 wajah 用于村庄等事物的“外观”义机械套到这里。普通交谈常说 muka aku；较正式的个人陈述通常说 wajah saya。连写规则参见：[DBP《马来语通用拼写指南》](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Wajahku combines a word for face with the attached first-person form -ku. Its cultural interest lies in how a small grammatical ending changes the voice: wajah describes a face, while wajahku places the speaker inside the image. That compact personal perspective suits lyrics, reflective narration, and intimate descriptions of expression.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: wa-jah 是“面容”，ku 是“我的”：给 wajah 贴上 ku，就把镜头转向自己的脸。

etymology.historical_story: Wasiat comes from Arabic and carries the idea of a final instruction. In Malay historical literature, its significance extends beyond possessions: a dying ruler may leave a successor an injunction to govern justly. The word thus connects inheritance with moral responsibility, preserving both material wishes and advice intended to outlive the speaker. Source: [DBP encyclopedia](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=wasiat).

etymology.historical_story: Walking belongs to English and is transparently formed from walk plus -ing. Its appearance inside a Malay conversation illustrates language contact: an English activity word can occupy a familiar place in a Malay sentence. This conversational use does not establish an official Malay borrowing; the ordinary Malay expression remains berjalan kaki.

etymology.historical_story: The firearms name commemorates Oliver Winchester. In 1866, he reorganized the business as the Winchester Repeating Arms Company, and the Model 1866 became the first rifle to carry the Winchester name. This explains how a personal surname became a brand and, through ordinary reference, a name for its rifles. [Library of Congress](https://guides.loc.gov/american-firearms/gunmakers/winchester)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Dewan definition illustrates wisel with a train departure, while its learner's dictionary illustrates the end of a game. These scenes reveal a useful cultural connection: a small sound-making device can coordinate a crowd. Remembering the station and the playing field also anchors the word's concrete meaning. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=wisel).

senses.en_definition: Living or growing naturally, without domestication or cultivation.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, hidup atau tumbuh secara semula jadi tanpa dijinakkan atau ditanam.
senses.nuances: 马来语通常用 liar。以下 ms 字段为马来语对应表达；wild 本身仍按英语词处理。[英语释义来源](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/wild)

senses.zh_definition: 英语：失控的、狂放的或情绪异常强烈的。
senses.en_definition: Uncontrolled, unruly, or intensely excited.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, tidak terkawal atau terlalu teruja.
senses.nuances: 形容人时可能是批评，也可能在熟人玩笑中表示惊叹；不是所有语境都适合译作 liar。

senses.zh_definition: 英语：异乎寻常、大胆离奇或令人震惊的。
senses.en_definition: Remarkably unconventional, extreme, or surprising.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, sangat luar biasa, melampau atau mengejutkan.
senses.nuances: 双语口语中的 wild 可表达赞叹或不敢相信；标准马来语须按语气选用 luar biasa、mengejutkan 等。

senses.zh_definition: 英语：缺乏事实依据或明显偏离准确值的。
senses.en_definition: Unsupported by evidence or far from accurate.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, tidak berasaskan bukti atau jauh daripada ketepatan.
senses.nuances: wild guess 侧重随意猜测；wild accusation 侧重指控缺乏根据。不能一律直译为“野生”。

senses.zh_definition: 英语：野外；生物自然生存的环境。
senses.en_definition: The natural environment outside captivity or cultivation.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, alam semula jadi di luar kurungan atau pemeliharaan.
senses.nuances: 此义常见于 in the wild、into the wild。马来语用 di alam liar、ke habitat semula jadi 等。

etymology.historical_story: English wild descends through Middle English from Old English wilde. Its history belongs to English rather than Malay word formation. The natural-state meaning supplies a memorable starting point for learning its figurative uses; a bilingual speaker can also insert the English word into a Malay sentence. [Source](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/wild)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 /waɪld/，脑中先出现野外自由奔跑的动物；再把“不受约束”的画面连到失控、狂放和惊人的意思。

senses.zh_definition: 为报道或播出而进行的问答式采访；通过向受访者提问获取情况、意见或说明的访谈。
senses.en_definition: An interview conducted to obtain information or opinions for publication or broadcast.
senses.ms_definition: Sesi soal jawab untuk memperoleh maklumat atau pandangan bagi tujuan penyiaran atau penerbitan.
senses.nuances: 属于规范词，常见于新闻、广播、人物专访和访谈文字。与 temu bual、temu ramah 近义；不限于采访名人。招聘面试通常用 temu duga。马来语释义依据 DBP 改写，并非逐字引文。[DBP 释义与用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=wawancara)。

etymology.historical_story: Wawancara names a familiar practice in public communication: asking questions so that another person’s experiences or views can reach an audience. DBP places it alongside temu bual and temu ramah, and its usage extends beyond interviews with celebrities. The consulted evidence establishes this modern meaning but does not establish a detailed historical borrowing route.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 wa.wan.ca.ra 四拍想成访谈轮流说话：一问、一答、再问、再答；这是记忆联想，不是词源拆分。

etymology.historical_story: Weasley belongs to the English fictional world of Harry Potter rather than to Malay word formation. Malay readers retain the surname when discussing Ron and his relatives. Its resemblance to weasel offers a useful literary association: Arthur Weasley's Patronus actually takes that animal's form. This association should not be mistaken for a productive Malay root or suffix. [Official Harry Potter feature](https://www.harrypotter.com/features/what-is-a-patronus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作“威兹利”：想到罗恩·韦斯莱，就把 Weasley 和他的家族联系起来；不要按马来语词缀拆开。

morphology.pattern_note: 未确认其为规范马来语普通词。若为人名，应写作 Willy，整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分；读音须依姓名持有者的语言及习惯确认。

senses.nuances: 本义项仅为有条件的人名解读，不能据频率排名认定为马来语普通词。英语另有同形普通名词 willy，属非正式用语，指阴茎，不能直接移植为马来语义项。[Cambridge 英语词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/willy)。下列搭配和例句仅示范人名用法，不代表已验证的高频搭配；因此本条不能标为 official。

etymology.historical_story: As a personal name, Willy belongs to a European naming tradition: English Willy is related to Willie and William, while German Willy is related to Willi and Wilhelm. senses.zh_definition: 因吃花生、糕点等食物而感到口渴的。
senses.en_definition: Thirsty after eating peanuts, cakes, or similar foods; used in Kelantan Malay.
senses.ms_definition: Kl berasa dahaga kerana makan kacang (kuih dll).
senses.nuances: 吉兰丹方言词，特指吃东西引起的口渴，不能直接扩大为所有原因造成的口渴。词典标签 Kl 指 Kelantan（吉兰丹），不是 Kuala Lumpur。收录于官方词典不等于适合全国通用公文；通用表达宜用 dahaga。下列搭配用于展示句法，不代表已有频率统计。[释义来源：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=war)。

dual_scenarios.zh: 在吉兰丹方言中，war 指因吃花生或糕点而感到口渴的状态。
dual_scenarios.en: In Kelantan Malay, the word war refers to feeling thirsty after eating peanuts or cakes.

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan records war as a Kelantan dialect word for thirst caused by eating peanuts, cakes, or similar foods. Its cultural interest lies in that precise everyday distinction: a local word singles out a sensation that broader Malay expresses with dahaga and an explanation. The cited entry provides no historical derivation, so an older origin cannot responsibly be supplied. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=war).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 war 和画面绑定：吃完花生，马上找水。记住“吃后口渴”，不要套入英语 war 的“战争”义。

morphology.formula: ∅ + w → w（字母）；W → tungsten（元素符号）
morphology.pattern_note: 字母和符号没有通常的派生词缀。IPA 表示字母名称 dabliu；字母在 wanita 等词中通常表示辅音 /w/。化学符号必须写大写 W。输入的 is_root 在此仅表示不可再作词缀拆分。

etymology.historical_story: The chemical symbol W preserves the alternative name wolfram, even though Malay calls the element tungsten. The two names reflect different strands of European mineral history. This explains an otherwise puzzling mismatch: the symbol does not begin with the first letter of tungsten, because it remembers another established name for the same element. [Royal Society of Chemistry](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/74/TungstenH)

etymology.historical_story: Woi belongs to the expressive vocabulary of calling and reacting. Regional dictionaries record it as an attention call, while conversation gives the same short sound different social effects. Between close friends it can sound familiar; shouted sharply, it can signal anger or warning. Similarity to oi does not by itself establish a borrowing direction or a precise historical origin.

etymology.historical_story: One verified context for Walt is the name Walt Disney. Disney's own history explains that WED Enterprises took its initials from Walter Elias Disney, connecting the familiar Walt with his fuller name. This is a documented proper-name connection, not evidence that lowercase walt has a Malay lexical origin or that the unidentified input necessarily refers to Disney. See [Disney's official history](https://sites.disney.com/waltdisneyimagineering/our-story/).

etymology.historical_story: The parliamentary term comes from the eighteenth-century hunting expression whipper-in: an assistant who kept hounds from straying from the pack. Politics borrowed that image for officials who keep party members together for parliamentary business and votes. Malaysian parliamentary records use the borrowed title in expressions such as Ketua Whip Kerajaan. [Sources: UK Parliament](https://www.parliament.uk/about/mps-and-lords/principal/whips/), [Malaysian Parliament](https://parlimen.gov.my/files/hindex/pdf/DR-21072020.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: English were continues Middle English were and weren, which developed from Old English forms including wǣre and wǣron. It preserves an older distinction within the unusually irregular verb be. Its appearance in Malaysian multilingual writing can therefore represent English material rather than a Malay derivative; this packet alone does not establish a separate Malay word. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=were)

etymology.historical_story: Wajib is an Arabic borrowing associated with obligation. In Malay religious discourse, it names a category of acts that believers must perform. Its everyday use also covers compulsory attendance and other requirements. This connection makes the word memorable: the same expression can signal religious duty, institutional necessity, or a strongly felt moral responsibility. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=wajib)

etymology.historical_story: Wonder continues Old English wundor, associated with extraordinary things, and wundrian, meaning to feel astonishment. Related forms survive in other Germanic languages, including German Wunder. Its modern meanings preserve two connected responses to the unfamiliar: admiring something remarkable and asking questions about something not yet understood. Its ultimate origin remains uncertain. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/wonder)

etymology.historical_story: Waktu comes from Arabic waqt, meaning time. Malay adapted the borrowed word with a final vowel, producing waktu. The form waktumu then combines this established noun with the Malay second-person enclitic -mu. It illustrates how a borrowed word can participate naturally in Malay grammar without borrowing the source language's possessive system.

etymology.historical_story: Warna belongs to the Sanskrit-derived vocabulary shared across the Malay world, ultimately associated with varṇa, meaning colour or appearance. Malay combines this established word with -nya to identify whose colour, or which previously mentioned colour, is intended. The resulting form illustrates how an inherited borrowing participates naturally in productive Malay grammar. See [WOLD: warna](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839634588480).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 warna＝颜色，再接 nya＝它的：warna＋nya，就是“它的颜色”。ny 连读成一个 /ɲ/ 音。

etymology.historical_story: Wan illustrates how Malay social vocabulary preserves both status and family relationships. Kamus Dewan records a noble title alongside regional kinship meanings: aunt in Perak, grandmother in Pahang and Negeri Sembilan, and grandfather in Kedah. These documented uses reveal a cultural map of address, but they do not establish one shared origin for every meaning or justify a speculative historical derivation.

etymology.historical_story: Warganegara brings together warga, a member of a community, and negara, a state or country. The combination makes national membership explicit. In Malaysian administrative language, it identifies the person, while kewarganegaraan names the status. Its established single-word spelling also shows how a compound can become a stable base for further Malay word formation.

etymology.historical_story: Wanita belongs to Malay's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary and is traced to Sanskrit vanitā, meaning woman. Modern Malay uses it as a refined term in public and institutional contexts. Wanitanya adds the Malay enclitic -nya, linking the woman or women to an established referent rather than creating a separate historical root. [Wanita etymology](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/wanita)

etymology.historical_story: Would belongs to the English grammatical history of will, rather than to Malay affixation. Its present uses reach beyond past time: speakers use it for imagined outcomes, polite requests and tentative judgments. That range explains why translating every occurrence with Malay akan produces errors; the surrounding construction determines the appropriate equivalent. [Source: British Council](https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/english-grammar-reference/will-would).

etymology.historical_story: Warrior entered Middle English through northern French forms referring to someone who waged war. Its history belongs to English, rather than Malay word formation. In Malaysian gaming conversations, it can appear as an English character-class label, while Malay has established equivalents such as pahlawan and kesateria. etymology.historical_story: The dictionary distinguishes two homonymous entries. Arabic-derived wa survives in expressions conveying coordination or an oath, including wallahuaklam and wallahi. A separate wa appears in Malay kinship titles such as pak wa and mak wa, with an additional colloquial sweetheart sense. Their shared spelling should not be treated as evidence that all these meanings have one origin. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=wa)

etymology.historical_story: Webb began as an English occupational surname associated with weaving. It comes from Old English webba, meaning a weaver, rather than from a Malay root. That historical meaning explains the surname's formation; it does not make a modern bearer a weaver. In Malay, the name travels intact with the person or named object it identifies. See [Behind the Name: Webb](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/webb).

etymology.historical_story: Winston became a given name through an English surname. The surname has more than one possible historical source: an older personal name, Wynnstan, or English place names associated with someone called Wine. These alternatives prevent a single literal translation from explaining every family history. Malay preserves Winston as a name rather than rebuilding it from Malay word parts. See [Behind the Name: Winston](https://www.behindthename.com/name/winston).

etymology.historical_story: English wait came through Anglo-French forms meaning to watch over or await, with an earlier Germanic background. The history connects keeping watch with remaining until something happens. In a mixed Malay sentence, the word retains its English identity; an occurrence in conversation alone does not establish it as an official Malay borrowing. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/wait).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: wait /weɪt/ 可联想“喂，等一下！”；标准马来语换成 tunggu，礼貌一点说 Sila tunggu sebentar。

etymology.historical_story: Walk descends through Middle English from Old English verbs associated with rolling, tossing and working with the hands. Its meanings broadened before travelling on foot became central. That history is an English development: a Malay speaker using walk in conversation is switching languages, rather than using a word derived from Malay jalan. [Merriam-Webster: walk](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/walk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: walk 的 l 不出声：把它想成静静站在路边的人，让 /wɔːk/ 自己走过去。马来语对应 berjalan kaki。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语独立单音节词；常见读音中 wh 为 /w/，部分口音保留 /ʍ/。不能拆作马来语词根与词缀。

etymology.historical_story: Whit comes through Middle English from Old English wiht. The older word developed an amount sense, preserved in expressions about the smallest possible degree. Today, phrases such as not a whit keep it recognizable even when speakers rarely use it alone. Its history is English, not evidence of a Malay borrowing. [American Heritage etymology](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=whit).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /wɪt/ 和一粒小点联系起来：not a whit，就是连这么一点也没有。

etymology.historical_story: Woman developed from Old English wīfman, combining an element meaning woman or wife with man in its older sense of person. That history explains the word’s structure without making it a modern description of marital status. Present-day woman includes adult women whether married or unmarried. See [Merriam-Webster’s word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/woman).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 单数 woman /ˈwʊmən/，复数 women /ˈwɪmɪn/：人数变多，前面的元音也跟着变。
